scope: all current and future material agent/chat/workflow tasks in Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse
purpose: Prevent work from stopping at analysis, code, proposal, ready-for-deploy, or an unverified success claim. Require completion through production/live verification, canonical learning writeback and reusable agent handoff whenever technically possible.
blocked_hard_boundary_rule: When a required write/deploy/provider action is technically unavailable or requires forbidden secrets, permission changes, destructive irreversible data operations, paid resource increases, or legally/financially binding action, complete every safe executable step, preserve an explicit canonical open obligation, and never claim the missing action was executed.
prevention: No current or future Powerhouse agent may stop at advice, local change, PR-ready, deploy-ready, an unverified success claim, or undocumented implementation knowledge when the next safe execution or handoff step is available. Work continues through live outcome verification, canonical registration, reusable agent handoff and learning writeback.
